current_concerns.primary_problems: At home, I become very preoccupied with food and meal planning. I frequently count calories and think about what I can or cannot eat. This has been occurring since age 18. Although my weight has increased somewhat over the past year, I still feel stuck with these concerns. Worrying about food and counting calories make it harder to spend time with friends and participate in everyday activities; I avoid eating with other people, which sometimes creates awkwardness, and I plan my day around food.
current_concerns.goals: I would like to be able to eat a meal with friends without planning it for days, and to stop feeling that I have to organize everything around food all the time.
